gates.requirement: Independent assembly, chemical graph, atom map and local structural reference checks for all eligible cases
Analytic metric controls plus AAV9 and six unrelated nonviral development cases, including linked glycans
Frozen eligible families, leakage audit, precision target, independent tested specificity labels
Paired information, conformation and assembly comparisons, failure denominators, family-aware uncertainty
Independent end-to-end replay from archived sources and raw outputs

interpretation: Development oracle redocking can validate implementation. It cannot establish blind site recovery, molecular specificity, or universal docking reliability.
